check.definisi:
CHECK (
CASE tipe
    WHEN 'satuan_sewa'::text THEN ((persen IS NULL) AND (plafon_persen IS NULL) AND (masa_tenggang IS NULL) AND (nominal IS NULL) AND (tanggal IS NULL))
    WHEN 'jatuh_tempo'::text THEN ((persen IS NULL) AND (plafon_persen IS NULL) AND (masa_tenggang IS NULL) AND (nominal IS NULL) AND
    CASE
        WHEN ((nilai)::text = 'tanggal_tetap'::text) THEN ((tanggal IS NOT NULL) AND ((tanggal >= 1) AND (tanggal <= 31)))
        ELSE (tanggal IS NULL)
    END)
    WHEN 'denda'::text THEN ((tanggal IS NULL) AND
    CASE
        WHEN ((nilai)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['persen_harian'::character varying, 'persen_bulanan'::character varying])::text[])) THEN ((persen IS NOT NULL) AND (persen > (0)::numeric) AND (plafon_persen IS NOT NULL) AND (plafon_persen > (0)::numeric) AND (nominal IS NULL) AND (masa_tenggang IS NOT NULL) AND (masa_tenggang >= 0))
        WHEN ((nilai)::text = 'nominal_tetap'::text) THEN ((nominal IS NOT NULL) AND (nominal >= (0)::numeric) AND (persen IS NULL) AND (plafon_persen IS NULL) AND (masa_tenggang IS NULL))
        ELSE ((persen IS NULL) AND (plafon_persen IS NULL) AND (masa_tenggang IS NULL) AND (nominal IS NULL))
    END)
    ELSE NULL::boolean
END)

CHECK (((((tipe)::text = 'satuan_sewa'::text) AND ((nilai)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['bulanan'::character varying, 'mingguan'::character varying, 'harian'::character varying])::text[]))) OR (((tipe)::text = 'jatuh_tempo'::text) AND ((nilai)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['tanggal_masuk'::character varying, 'tanggal_tetap'::character varying, 'akhir_bulan'::character varying])::text[]))) OR (((tipe)::text = 'denda'::text) AND ((nilai)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['persen_harian'::character varying, 'persen_bulanan'::character varying, 'nominal_tetap'::character varying, 'tanpa_denda'::character varying])::text[])))))
